scene: The unwound copper ribbon reveals shining travel vouchers to distant destinations.
picture: Flat side-view across green grass. On the far left, a frozen-wheeled sleigh tram rests on frosty rails. In the centre, the boy in his orange puffer vest holds shimmering ribbon beside a glass-bottomed canal boat. On the right, a yellow hillside chairlift sways at its wooden boarding platform. Blue sky overhead.
shown: a frost-rimed sleigh tram waiting empty on tracks at the far left
a glass-bottomed boat moored beside a small canal dock in the centre
an open yellow chairlift swinging gently by a post on the right
